source:
A good approach is to make an original police vs. criminals game inspired by Justice Rivals 3, rather than copying its maps, assets, or branding.
Game Name
Urban Rivals: Crime Wars
Gameplay
Players choose a team:
👮 Police
🦹 Criminals
Police
Respond to robberies.
Arrest criminals with handcuffs.
Drive police cars and SWAT trucks.
Complete missions for cash.
Criminals
Rob banks, jewelry stores, and gas stations.
Steal civilian cars.
Escape from police.
Buy better weapons and vehicles.
Features
Huge open city.
Day/night cycle.
Working traffic.
Houses and apartments.
Weapon shop.
Vehicle dealership.
SWAT base.
Police station.
Criminal hideout.
XP and money system.
Character customization.
Leaderboards.
Weapons
Pistol
SMG
Shotgun
Assault rifle
Sniper rifle
Flashbang
Smoke grenade
Vehicles
Police cruiser
SWAT truck
Sports car
Pickup truck
Motorcycle
Armored van
Helicopter
Future Updates
Prison escape
Cargo ship robbery
Train robbery
Military base
Zombie mode
Private servers
More maps
This gives you the same cops-and-robbers feeling while being your own original Roblox game. If you'd like, I can also design the entire city map, including the police station, bank, neighborhoods, docks, airport, and criminal hideout.

image_prompt.text: An oversized downtown plaza where police and criminal players cross paths without traffic jams
Highly detailed spots built as backdrops for roleplay scenes - a city park, a fountain plaza, the docks
A distinct downtown high-rise visible across the whole city so players can navigate by sight
Wide, flat, grid-aligned city streets - 15 studs minimum one-way, 30 studs two-way - so cruisers, SWAT trucks, sports cars and motorcycles turn without clipping walls
Clear separation between the commercial strip holding the weapon shop and vehicle dealership and the quiet residential neighbourhoods of houses and apartments
Enterable banks, jewelry stores, gas stations, houses, apartments, the police station, the SWAT base and the criminal hideout
The police station and SWAT base at one end of the city and the criminal hideout at the other, shielded from each other's sightlines
docks and an airport as outlying city districts

layout_placement.text: Police spawn at the station and SWAT base, criminal spawn at the hideout, at opposite ends of the city
robbery objective volumes inside the bank, jewelry stores and gas stations that start a heist and alert the police team

notes: Close call between Roleplay & Avatar Sim and Shooter - classified Roleplay because the deliverable described is a whole city, with Shooter contributing opposing team bases only.
Preset caveat from the genre file: this genre is P3 by default in practice, and the enterable banks, station and hideout make that unavoidable here.
The weapon list, vehicle list, XP/money system and the 'Future Updates' section have no layout footprint and were not carried into the build.

open_questions.ask: How big is 'huge' - a few walkable blocks, or a full region with highway-length car chases?
What ends a round - an arrest, a successful escape, a cash total, or is the city persistent with no rounds at all?
Should every house and apartment be enterable, or only the robbery targets and the two faction bases?

answers.ask: How big is 'huge' - a few walkable blocks, or a full region with highway-length car chases?
answers.answer: Use a compact open city of a few connected, drivable blocks, with the main landmarks close enough to keep police chases active and playable.

answers.ask: What ends a round - an arrest, a successful escape, a cash total, or is the city persistent with no rounds at all?
answers.answer: Make it a persistent city with no rounds; players earn cash and XP through robberies, arrests, missions, and escapes.

answers.ask: Should every house and apartment be enterable, or only the robbery targets and the two faction bases?
answers.answer: Only robbery targets and the two faction bases need enterable interiors; houses and apartments can be exterior scenery for the first build.
